verdict.rationale: Poly documents a dedicated note-import path into Poly Mind from Notion, Evernote, Obsidian, Bear and others, and its general file migration preserves folder structure and metadata such as tags and colors. Nothing shows that internal links or note attachments survive the notes import, and Roam is not named. missing for 10: Roam import support, evidence that inter-note links and attachments are preserved, confirmation that structure is preserved specifically for note imports, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
